about_the_game:
Fever Meme is a comedy/parody game that pivots between multiple genres as it spits in the face of traditional game design.
One moment you'll be in a 2007-esque rage platformer, the next moment you'll be in the game show with a giant spider. But beneath all of the trolls and humor is a deeper overarching story. The game is self-aware of your actions as you play, your past mistakes, and so much more. And the further you make it into the game, the more the dynamic between player and creator is explored as the fourth wall is completely stripped away.

DISCLAIMER: Do not play if you are prone to photosensitive epilepsy or are sensitive to loud audio.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game may behave unpredictably at low frame rates (<45 FPS). Use of older laptops or integrated GPUs is not recommended.
